clockPolicy: Pause stores elapsed time; resume anchors to the new monotonic time.
A phase boundary stops the anchor; a late tick cannot consume the next phase.
Nanosecond-scale boundary tolerance avoids floating-point loss at rational frame times.
Replay resets practice, elapsed, anchor and feedback branch while retaining timing configuration.
